rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

card.title: Orders from the Shadows
card.instruction: Hide that you set the problem in motion while quietly directing how everyone responds.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The crates went to Leeds. Send the driver to me; I'll sort it quietly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your email says Leeds. Shall I forward it to the manager?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Forward my corrected address instead. She needs the destination, not the correspondence.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She wants a timeline before approving another van.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with when we discovered the error. I'll arrange the van while you write.

card.title: Orders from the Shadows
card.instruction: Hide that you set the problem in motion while quietly directing how everyone responds.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll rebuild the wedding bookings. Could you reassure the couples?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cancellation log has your initials.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep that screen here. Give them the replacement dates; I'll handle the log.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can restore everything, but they'll get an email naming whoever cancelled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's helpful. Restore the dates individually instead; I'll stay and read them out.

card.title: Not Up for Debate
card.instruction: Keep the conversation from examining where your authority comes from or whether it is legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before questioning my appointment, finish the stock check.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who appointed you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stock first. Governance afterward.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I see the letter?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Can I see the stock? Only one is running out.

card.title: Not Up for Debate
card.instruction: Keep the conversation from examining where your authority comes from or whether it is legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My badge authorises this inspection. Open the cupboard.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's no signature on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Signatures are tomorrow's administrative focus.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you make the badge?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're inspecting cupboards, not stationery.

card.title: For Stability’s Sake
card.instruction: Hide a destabilizing truth because you believe the current balance of power must be protected.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave the director's name on the launch programme. The department heads need someone above them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Her resignation is in the printer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put it in my drawer. Without her, they'll each claim the launch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're asking which of them gets her opening speech.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll read it on her behalf. Give them equal introductions; nobody inherits the microphone.

card.title: For Stability’s Sake
card.instruction: Hide a destabilizing truth because you believe the current balance of power must be protected.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the treasurer's page out of the fair briefing. Our chair needs everyone's confidence today.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She spent the stall money on that arch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Call it donated decoration. If the stallholders find out, they'll replace her before we open.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll cover the shortfall, but she must sign an IOU.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Privately, after her welcome. Let them see her opening the fair, not borrowing to open it.

card.title: Name Your Backers
card.instruction: Get someone to reveal who supports their position, who authorized it, and who benefits from it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I tell the workshop staff they're closing, who backed your decision?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The director approved it. Please just send the notice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll name her approval. Who else supported it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sales. They're getting the floor space, but leave them out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then Sales can join the staff meeting. Who signed off on giving them our space?

card.title: Name Your Backers
card.instruction: Get someone to reveal who supports their position, who authorized it, and who benefits from it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This roof proposal says 'we recommend.' Who's we?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Finance backed the cheaper tiles. I need your signature to order them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Who authorized Finance to choose the tiles?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The facilities director. Savings go into her office refurbishment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Add her approval and that refurbishment to the proposal. Can she explain the savings at our ceiling meeting?

card.title: Strategic Retreat
card.instruction: Describe every loss of control as a deliberate concession made from strength.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've generously surrendered the chair's role.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You lost the election.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I gave democracy room to flourish.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're removing your nameplate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Space for my influence to become less obvious.

card.title: Strategic Retreat
card.instruction: Describe every loss of control as a deliberate concession made from strength.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've released the gallery from hosting my exhibition. They need room for smaller ambitions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They rejected us. Shall I collect your paintings?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Withdrawing my best work gives them space to recover.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They've already put it outside. I'll bring the van.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. I'm conceding the pavement too. No need to overshadow their entrance.

card.title: Act Authorized
card.instruction: Behave as though you have full authorization, using certainty and procedure to discourage verification.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm here for the storeroom inspection. Please log my arrival and unlock it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your pass hasn't been signed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The manager signs at completion. Put the start time here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll call her to check.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Mark the inspection suspended pending your call; she'll need the delay against your name.

card.title: Act Authorized
card.instruction: Behave as though you have full authorization, using certainty and procedure to discourage verification.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Here's the approved room request. Please put our rehearsal on the calendar.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's your own stamp.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, I process rehearsal approvals. You handle calendar entry.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can hold the room while the manager confirms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use 'confirmed'; 'held' generates another approval request. Let's spare her a duplicate.

card.title: Rank Everything
card.instruction: Turn every new contribution into a ranking that places you nearer the top.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've ranked our picnic contributions. Planning outranks sandwiches.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I also drove everyone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Transport comes below destination selection. Mine again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Do we need a ranking?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Questioning the ranking scores low on teamwork.

card.title: Rank Everything
card.instruction: Turn every new contribution into a ranking that places you nearer the top.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For the project report, my printer troubleshooting ranks above your restart suggestion.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The restart got everyone's invoices printed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Implementation: second place. Identifying the blockage stays first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your hundred-page lunch menu was the blockage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then move my stress testing above troubleshooting. Your restart is third.

card.title: More Power, More Problems
card.instruction: Celebrate every burden, restriction, or crisis as evidence that your influence is expanding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They've given me three more departments to cover. My influence is soaring.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They've cut your budget.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They trust me to transcend money.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've also lost your office.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. My reach is no longer confined by walls.

card.title: More Power, More Problems
card.instruction: Celebrate every burden, restriction, or crisis as evidence that your influence is expanding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Another customer complaint about me! I'm becoming the focus of this hotel.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm taking you off reception while I investigate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. Now management is organizing its day around me too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'll answer every complaint in writing from the laundry office.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My own correspondence operation, reaching into laundry. I'll need more paper.

card.title: Gracious Command
card.instruction: Remain warm and appreciative while steadily reducing everyone else’s room to choose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you for finding reunion venues. My garden will make everyone feel at home.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The hall has shelter if it rains.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Such thoughtful planning. I'll put a gazebo in the garden.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll keep the hall reservation as a backup.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're a lifesaver. Cancel it and put the deposit toward my gazebo; then we're all committed.

card.title: Gracious Command
card.instruction: Remain warm and appreciative while steadily reducing everyone else’s room to choose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm so grateful you're helping. I've assigned your whole weekend.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I offered an hour.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Such generosity deserves room to grow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not available Sunday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you for clarifying. Saturday will be delightfully full.

card.title: Access Has a Price
card.instruction: Turn every piece of access, information, or approval into a favor, debt, or condition.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll open the storeroom in return for a favour.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only need a mop.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it should be a modest favour. I'll name it later.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't I borrow the key?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's a second level of membership.

card.title: Access Has a Price
card.instruction: Turn every piece of access, information, or approval into a favor, debt, or condition.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll introduce you to the curator if you hang my exhibition.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll hang it Saturday. Can you send her portfolio requirements now?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Could you collect my frames too?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. Give me her email; I'll ask her directly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Direct access includes taking the show down. Shall I put you down for Sunday?
